LAYER 03 · SELF-ATTENTION · A REAL MODEL

How the model works.

A real 200,320-parameter transformer I trained on my CV in under two minutes on a laptop. It runs in your browser with zero network calls. The arcs are its actual attention weights. Words it never saw get crossed out. It's tiny, so it can hallucinate, just like the big ones.
